subject: english
stem: A friend asks about your free-time activity. Which answer is complete and relevant?
options: The park was a photo tomorrow.
I often take photos of birds in the park.
Free time is after a clock.

optionRationales.reason: The park was a photo tomorrow.：時態與名詞關係錯誤。
I often take photos of birds in the park.：活動、頻率與地點構成相關回答。
Free time is after a clock.：沒有提供活動。
Birds often take my name.：主客體與語意不合理。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「以喜好動詞、活動名稱與頻率線索描述興趣或日常活動，並區分喜好與實際作息。」可推出 I often take photos of birds in the park.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 I often take photos of birds in the park. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
